ranked.headline: Learned models integrate spatial, single-cell, and multiomics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply deep generative, contrastive, and graph-based models to spatial transcriptomics, single-cell, and multiomics data.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of regulatory activity from transcript, chromatin and cfDNA data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply splicing-aware, hybrid, and allele-resolved readouts to infer regulatory programs at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware scoring links protein sequence variation to folding and selection data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair language-model embeddings and structure with experimental folding, aggregation, and selection data to score sequence changes.

ranked.headline: Open-source software standardises omics, imaging and network analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers release installable tools that lower the programming barrier for multimodal omics, imaging and cancer progression modelling.

ranked.headline: Neural genomic models aim for interpretable readouts of regulatory sequence function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether added structure, ontology, or wavelet encodings make DNA and single-cell model predictions interpretable and generalizable.

ranked.headline: Trajectory-based modeling resolves aging-linked depletion and regulatory dynamics
ranked.summary: Population-scale laboratory records and single-cell measurements now allow aging to be resolved as continuous, time-indexed trajectories.

ranked.headline: Feedback and canalization set robustness in cell fate and tissue dynamical systems
ranked.summary: Recent models link bifurcation proximity, canalization, and feedback to robust population control, attractor stability, and polarity in cells and tissues.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks for molecular property prediction, generation and interaction
ranked.summary: Recent work couples graph-based molecular representations with property, synthesis, and activity constraints in generation and prediction.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient segmentation across histology, electron microscopy and cryo-ET imaging
ranked.summary: Self-training, self-supervision and foundation-model fine-tuning are reducing annotation demands for quantitative microscopy and pathology segmentation.

ranked.headline: Generative models are designing target-specific ligands and drug-like molecules
ranked.summary: Diffusion, VAE, and language-model generators are now coupled to explicit energy, property, and active-learning scoring for molecular design.

ranked.headline: Computational tools assign phage and virus genomes to hosts, lifestyles, and taxa
ranked.summary: Scalable ML and pretrained genomic language models now annotate viral lifestyle, taxonomy, and host-associated genomes across large public and metagenomic…

ranked.headline: Long-read alignments and methylation guide misassembly and phasing error correction
ranked.summary: Long-read data increasingly supports reference-free assembly validation and methylation-aware phasing, alongside scalable k-mer and ancestry tools.

ranked.headline: Transformer language model embeddings are repurposed for variant and target prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained DNA, protein, and text language models are now coupled to task-specific heads for regulatory, clinical, and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict viral evolution, RNA structure, and protein effects
ranked.summary: Task-specific sequence models now target viral mutation, RNA folding, protein shrinking and binding free energy changes directly from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model features fused for protein, drug, and kinase prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method add language-model embeddings and learned relational context to sequence and structure features.

ranked.headline: Software for microbial pan-genome, phylogenetic marker, and genome annotation analysis
ranked.summary: Expanding microbial genome catalogues and new pan-genome and marker-selection methods make large-scale comparative genomics more tractable.

ranked.headline: MD maps distal allosteric couplings in RNA-binding, chromatin, and spike proteins
ranked.summary: Residue-level interaction networks paired with metastable-state and pathway analysis now resolve specific allosteric routes across five recent MD studies.

ranked.headline: Topological and neighborhood methods infer tissue organization from spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply persistent homology, set transformers and spatial statistics to infer tissue structure from spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Task-specific sequence workflows and curated genomic resources for defined data types
ranked.summary: Distinct metabarcoding, genome-assembly and gene-transfer resources now target specific data classes rather than general-purpose analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative models design mRNA sequences with enhanced translation and stability
ranked.summary: Generative mRNA design papers now report translation and stability gains in vitro and in mice, alongside new RNA-targeting and benchmarking tools.

ranked.headline: Computational methods probe predicted protein structure, interaction, and disorder at…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply component ablation, proteome-wide screening, and language-model embeddings to predicted human protein features.

ranked.headline: Learned models are advancing biomolecular conformational dynamics and kinetics
ranked.summary: Physics-informed, coupled-dynamics, and coarse-grained learned models now target biomolecular motion, kinetics, and metastable states.

ranked.headline: Local structural rules set collective dynamics in condensates, tissues, and neurons
ranked.summary: Four recent items link specific mechanistic rules to network-level behavior in condensates, epithelia, and neuronal cultures.

ranked.headline: Modeling immunity build-up, waning, and reinfection across host and population scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize how protection builds, decays, and is renewed, linking vaccine timing to reinfection dynamics.

ranked.headline: EEG-based models link brain-state rhythms to sleep, consciousness and Fragile X
ranked.summary: Individual-level and whole-brain EEG models are now linked to sleep, consciousness, and adaptive stimulation in recent preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Language-model agents are being built into single-cell and spatial annotation workflows
ranked.summary: Open-weight models and evidence-checking agents now make LLM-based interpretation of transcriptomes testable against deterministic baselines.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts tandem spectra for PTM peptides and DIA spectral libraries
ranked.summary: Zero-shot PTM spectrum prediction and experiment-specific DIA library generation are shifting spectrum prediction away from fixed, domain-trained predictors.

ranked.headline: Bootstrap and benchmarking methods assess reliability of inferred biological networks
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether learned network differences and inference-tool edge recovery can be trusted against known ground truth.

ranked.headline: Metagenome sequencing depth limits recovery of microbial functional repertoires
ranked.summary: Modeling indicates whole metagenome sequencing recovers only about 60% of estimated microbiome function even at full depth, motivating improved recovery…

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models rank therapeutic gene targets by encoding biological structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply network, Boolean, and LLM-agent models to nominate cancer and CAR-T targets, with at least one validated only retrospectively.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links gene loss, deletions, and recombination to animal evolution
ranked.summary: Large-scale comparative analyses of 154 animal genomes, 22 mammal alignments, and gibbon resequencing now test evolutionary hypotheses directly across lineages.

ranked.headline: Anisotropic models relate tissue structure to stress, strain, and fluid flow
ranked.summary: Anisotropic and regionally resolved tissue models now infer stress, fluid flow, and in vivo material parameters from strain and membrane data.

ranked.headline: Inferring mechanistic model parameters and structure from data under imposed constraints
ranked.summary: Constrained estimation tools and simulation-based benchmarks are emerging to test and deploy data-driven inference of biological dynamics.

ranked.headline: Coupling structure hallucination and guided diffusion to steer protein design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints layer guiding potentials, structure hallucination and interpretable kernels onto protein design and stability prediction models.

ranked.headline: Docking benchmarks and automated QC/MM and virtual screening tools for biomolecular…
ranked.summary: Docking and hybrid simulation tools are being benchmarked and packaged into automated, accessible workflows for biomolecular systems.
